cand.title: CEMA Summit 2026
cand.excerpt: Three-day Toronto summit at Sheraton Centre with more than 850 corporate event marketers, strategists and industry partners from 19 countries, 40+ education sessions and 145 Canadian participants; strong meeting, catering, banquet, AV and visitor-room demand profile.
cand.selectionWhy: Prior ledger / named missing-segment recovery target

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Brian Mason, VP of Strategy & Operations, CEMA, is explicitly the Summit FAQ contact for sponsorship/partner opportunities and additional Summit questions; public email brian@cemaonline.com. Mykayla Smith, Manager, Strategic Events and Membership, CEMA, is described by the official staff biography as overseeing event planning and execution; public email mykayla@cemaonline.com. Both are commercially relevant organizer contacts, not proven hotel-contract signatories. No named housing procurement lead was established.
findings.futureEdition: CEMA Summit 2027 is officially announced for July 25–27, 2027, Denver, Colorado, United States, at Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel. Dates and city are corroborated by PCMA’s post-event release and September 2026 CEO update; the venue is explicitly named in the CEMA Summit page’s 2027 announcement. That page retains stale Toronto headings, 2026 agenda and travel content: these must not be carried into the Denver edition. No official 2028 CEMA Summit edition announcement was located; do not infer dates or a Toronto return.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment using the supplied hotel specifications: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is an urban Harbourfront hotel, not a resort. Its 157 guestrooms and approximately 240-theatre largest room cannot accommodate the entire historical 850-plus Summit as a single-property residential/plenary event. If a future Toronto programme is confirmed, plausible roles are a separately sourced 15–109-peak-room subgroup, speakers/VIPs, or small side meetings, not exclusive Summit housing. That range is a sales-fit target, not published event demand. The historical venue was a downtown Sheraton, not MTCC or Exhibition Place; proximity to those facilities does not itself create this demand. Reception/banquet proposals require operational catering and restaurant/lounge verification. There is no local lodging fit for the announced Denver edition.
findings.venueCommitments: 2026 actually took place August 9–11 at Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel, 123 Queen Street West, Toronto, Ontario, Canada: downtown Toronto proper, in the Financial District, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. The August 13 press-release date is not an activity date. The announced 2027 venue is Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel in Denver, Colorado, outside this hotel’s territory. An announced venue is evidenced; executed contracts, exclusivity and room allocations are not publicly established.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: August 4–6, 2024, Seattle, Washington, at Seattle Convention Center – Summit Building, with attendee lodging at Sheraton Grand Seattle reported by Meetings Today; July 27–29, 2025, Fairmont Austin, Austin, Texas; August 9–11, 2026, Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel, Toronto, Ontario; next announced July 25–27, 2027, Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel, Denver, Colorado. CEMA explicitly calls Summit annual. This establishes recurrence and changing destinations, not a fixed rotation or future Toronto commitment.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2026 host-hotel booking pathway was edition-specific. Official FAQ: “Hotel reservations at the Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel can be made during the registration process or via the Participant Portal after you complete your registration.” The FAQ identifies RainFocus as the registration platform, not as a housing bureau or hotel buyer. Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel is the only hotel named for the 2026 reservation pathway in the official materials reviewed. No additional 2026 overflow/block hotel, external official housing bureau, open hotel RFP, public room allocation, room rate or room-night total was located. For 2027, Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel is the announced venue; a 2027-specific lodging booking process, block inventory and housing operator remain unconfirmed. Do not reuse the 2026 FAQ as Denver housing evidence.
findings.organizationStructure: The Corporate Event Marketing Association is an association and a PCMA subsidiary, not an identified PCO, DMC or corporate end-client. CEMA is the named organizer in PCMA event listings. PCMA/CEMA provide the ownership and leadership context; Sheraton is the venue/host-hotel incumbent, and RainFocus is the published registration platform. No separate appointed PCO or housing bureau was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: 2026 already had an official Sheraton Centre Toronto reservation channel and has finished. Attendance of more than 850 does not establish guestrooms needed, a sell-out, compression or overflow. No sourced overflow request, unmet room demand or Radisson allocation was found. For 2027 the announced venue is another Sheraton in Denver; that is not evidence of an available Toronto block or of a fully contracted Denver housing programme.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Do not quote or reserve a speculative 2027 Toronto block. Send Brian Mason a concise permission-based introduction, copying Mykayla Smith, acknowledging the completed Toronto Summit and the Denver 2027 announcement. Ask whether any separately sourced Toronto executive, regional or future Summit component is planned; who manages destination/hotel selection; and when a Toronto-relevant RFP or supplier review could occur. Only if a local brief exists, request peak rooms, stay pattern, meeting sizes, incumbent obligations and overflow rules before offering a limited block. Verify hotel catering/restaurant operations internally before any food-and-beverage proposal. This is account development, not confirmed event revenue.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of November 15, 2026, Toronto 2026 is historical and outside the December 6, 2026–June 2028 opportunity horizon. Denver 2027 is upcoming within the horizon but outside Toronto. Therefore this candidate is not an accessible near-term Toronto Summit lodging lead. Retain historical account context rather than publishing an open hotel-sourcing opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: relationship development with CEMA could position the hotel for a later Toronto small-group programme or a separately sourced component if Summit returns. Neither a Toronto return nor such a programme is verified, and no 2028 edition was officially located. The observed city-hotel/convention-centre rotation supports an urban small-component pitch, not a resort buyout or whole-Summit bid. CEMA describes its community as non-selling and peer-to-peer, so seek organizer permission rather than treating participants as a prospecting list.
